stories.headline: IoT and AI in 2026: Market Scale, Architecture Shifts, and Industry Impact
stories.dek: KaaIoT's analysis finds the global AI-in-IoT space valued at up to 99 billion dollars in 2026, growing at a 14-22 percent CAGR through 2031, with North America holding 41 percent share and Asia-Pacific expanding fastest. Architecture is shifting from centralised cloud to distributed edge-cloud hybrids.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Numan Ali on Unsplash

stories.headline: Product Designer Jobs Spain 2026: Startup and Scale-Up Opportunities on Wellfound
stories.dek: Wellfound's Spain board features product designer roles at funded startups and Series B-to-D scale-ups, with equity packages and remote flexibility as common differentiators. The concentration of AI and fintech startups in Barcelona and Madrid is driving demand for designers comfortable with ambiguity.
stories.imageCredit: Photo by Álvaro Bernal on Unsplash

stories.headline: Rivian downsizes DOE loan to $4.5B for Georgia factory
stories.dek: Rivian has reworked its loan deal with the Department of Energy and now expects to borrow $4.5 billion to build its new factory in Georgia, down from the original amount of $6.6 billion.
